Project-authored fictional turn lifecycle V1. No real Magic rule authority.
On crossing ending/end into the next beginning/start, change active player, clear mana and reset land allowances as in the fictional kernel. Give no priority yet. Schedule untap_active_player, draw_for_turn, then perform_state_based_actions in that exact order.
Untap every known battlefield object controlled by the active player, regardless of owner, with known tap state and complete unrestricted supported semantics. Unknown state and unimplemented restrictions block the operation; no automatic override is assumed.
Draw exactly one object from index zero of the explicit active-player exclusive library_order. Move it to that player's exclusive hand, preserve owner and assign controller to that player. Remove that object from library_order. No random selection, shuffling or hidden identity inference occurs. Drawing from an empty library is unsupported, without a loss conclusion.
Only after the checkpoint completes may the active player receive priority in beginning/start. There is no upkeep, draw-step response window, first-turn exception, replacement or trigger procedure in this fictional profile.
The progress marker binds the active player and turn; queued operations cannot repeat once completed. An explicitly supplied settled initial position declares its turn-start operations already complete; initialization does not secretly execute them.
